vision.title: Freedom, family, creativity and ownership
vision.statement: Build a financially independent life with my wife, split seasonally between Ibiza and the UK, funded by valuable businesses, property projects and a trusted personal brand, with close friendships and time for the things I enjoy.
principles: Freedom is the outcome, not endless work
Build income first, then convert income into assets, skills and options
Design the plan with my wife, not around her
Protect health, relationships and enjoyment while building
Use clear thresholds before making irreversible moves
anti_goals: Being permanently dependent on one employer
Growing a business that owns all of my time
Moving countries before income and visa requirements are proven
Risking all property capital on one poorly understood deal
Becoming visible online without building a life I actually enjoy

phases.title: 1. Stability and runway
phases.description: Secure strong London income, define household numbers and create a disciplined allocation for business building and personal development.

phases.title: 2. Prove the engines
phases.description: Prove repeatable Airbnb management income, planning-uplift capability, consistent content output and a genuine London network before adding complexity.

phases.title: 3. Earn location freedom
phases.description: Move to the Ibiza and UK seasonal rhythm only when income, operations, marriage logistics and the digital nomad visa route are ready.

phases.title: 4. Compound capital and enterprise value
phases.description: Use property equity and earned capital carefully, build a repeatable property-flip capability and make the Airbnb business valuable without Phil.

phases.title: 5. Realise the designed life
phases.description: Exit the business at the right value, buy the dream home when affordable, preserve the seasonal lifestyle and keep creating.

outcomes.title: Secure the right London job
outcomes.outcome_statement: Get a new job in London earning £60,000 per year with 100% OTE.
outcomes.why: Create stable cash flow, confidence and investment capacity while building the next chapter.
definition_of_done: Signed employment contract for a suitable London-based role
Compensation meets the clarified salary and OTE definition
Role supports the wider business and life plan rather than consuming all available energy
milestones: Define exact target roles, industries and non-negotiables
Clarify whether £60k is base salary with £60k variable or £60k total OTE
Build a target-employer and application pipeline
Complete interviews and evaluate offers against the life plan
Accept and start the best-fit role
next_actions: Write the compensation definition and role scorecard
Set the target date for signing an offer
Review the existing Jobs dashboard against this exact brief
open_questions: Does £60k mean base salary, with another £60k variable at 100% OTE?
What is the latest acceptable start date?
How many office days per week are acceptable?
Which role titles and industries are in scope?
What workload or travel would make a role incompatible with the business plan?
risks: Taking a higher-paying job that leaves no energy to build the business
Optimising for title rather than income, flexibility and learning

outcomes.title: Convert income into capability and business growth
outcomes.outcome_statement: Use employment income to invest in the Airbnb management business and personal development, including learning to source planning-uplift deals.
outcomes.why: Turn earned income into skills, business assets and future wealth rather than lifestyle inflation.
definition_of_done: A written monthly allocation for household costs, safety, business and learning
Airbnb investments are tied to measurable commercial outcomes
A credible planning-uplift learning path is completed and applied to real opportunities
milestones: Map household baseline and available monthly surplus
Set investment rules before the new salary arrives
Choose planning-uplift education and mentors using evidence, not hype
Complete a first live deal appraisal
Build a repeatable sourcing and appraisal process
next_actions: Define the monthly money waterfall
List the exact planning skills to acquire
Set a maximum learning budget and evidence standard
open_questions: How much monthly cash can be invested without stressing household finances?
What emergency fund must remain untouched?
Which planning-uplift skills are missing today?
What evidence would justify paying for a course, mentor or community?
risks: Buying education without applying it
Starving the household buffer to fund speculative growth
Spreading capital across too many projects

outcomes.title: Reach £4,000 monthly business income and qualify for Ibiza
outcomes.outcome_statement: Earn £4,000 per month from the Airbnb management business, then move to Ibiza with my wife using the digital nomad visa route.
outcomes.why: Replace dependency on employment with portable income and begin the location-flexible life.
definition_of_done: The £4,000 monthly target is precisely defined and reached for an agreed proof period
Operations can run reliably while Phil is in Ibiza
The couple agrees the move, budget and timing
Professional immigration advice confirms an eligible digital nomad visa route
milestones: Define whether £4,000 means revenue, gross profit or personal net income
Define the customer and property-unit target behind £4,000
Build repeatable acquisition, onboarding and operations
Hold the target for the agreed number of months
Confirm visa, tax, healthcare and household logistics with qualified advisers
Move only after the readiness gate is met
next_actions: Define the £4,000 metric and proof period
Document the current business baseline
Calculate how many managed properties and what margin are required
open_questions: Is £4,000 revenue, business profit or personal take-home income?
How many consecutive months prove the income is reliable?
What does your wife need from the move?
What visa, tax and social-security advice is required?
What must operate without you before relocating?
risks: Moving on fragile revenue
Confusing turnover with spendable income
Visa or tax assumptions proving wrong
Business operations tying Phil to the phone

outcomes.title: Turn property equity into flip capital and a dream home
outcomes.outcome_statement: Sell my current property and use the capital to fund property flips, generating more capital that can eventually help buy our dream home.
outcomes.why: Convert existing equity into an active capital-growth engine and a meaningful family asset.
definition_of_done: The current property sale decision passes a rigorous hold-versus-sell analysis
Tax, fees, debt repayment and true deployable equity are known
The first flip meets written buying and risk criteria
Capital compounds without putting the household’s security at unacceptable risk
The dream-home fund reaches its defined target

success_metrics.label: Maximum capital at risk per deal

milestones: Complete hold-versus-sell appraisal
Calculate net proceeds after mortgage, tax and fees
Define flip buy box and risk rules
Build the professional team and funding plan
Complete one controlled first flip
Repeat only after a full post-project review
Define the dream home and required deposit or purchase fund
next_actions: Commission a current valuation and net-proceeds calculation
Write the flip buy box before viewing deals
Define the dream-home number and location criteria
open_questions: Which property will be sold and when?
What are the expected net proceeds after every cost?
What return and contingency are required for a flip?
How much capital must never be put at risk?
What exactly is the dream home, where is it and what will it cost?
risks: Selling a strong long-term asset without a better risk-adjusted use for the equity
Underestimating tax, finance, refurbishment or holding costs
Concentrating capital in one project

outcomes.title: Build and sell the Airbnb management business for £1m
outcomes.outcome_statement: Build the Airbnb management business into a company that can be sold for £1,000,000.
outcomes.why: Create a major liquidity event and prove the ability to build a valuable, transferable company.
definition_of_done: The business produces predictable, documented revenue and profit
Customer concentration and founder dependence are controlled
Systems, team, contracts and reporting survive due diligence
A credible buyer completes a transaction valuing Phil’s proceeds at the clarified £1m target
milestones: Define the likely buyer and valuation method
Build the £4,000 monthly proof engine
Choose the scale model and geographic focus
Systemise sales, onboarding, operations and quality control
Build management information and clean accounts
Reduce founder dependence
Prepare for buyer conversations and due diligence
Sell only when value and life timing align
next_actions: Define whether £1m means headline valuation or net proceeds
Reverse-engineer revenue and profit required at realistic multiples
List the business assets a buyer would value
open_questions: Does £1m mean sale price, enterprise value or net proceeds after tax?
Who is the likely buyer?
What valuation multiple is realistic for this model?
What revenue, profit and contract base would support that value?
How many hours per week may the business require from Phil at exit?
risks: Building a job rather than a sellable business
Scaling low-margin or operationally fragile contracts
Assuming a valuation multiple without comparable evidence

outcomes.title: Live seasonally between Ibiza and the UK
outcomes.outcome_statement: Live in Ibiza during the summer doing things I enjoy, and in London or elsewhere in the UK during the winter while working on property.
outcomes.why: Design the year around climate, creativity, relationships, property and enjoyment rather than a fixed default location.
definition_of_done: A repeatable annual rhythm is agreed with my wife
Both locations are financially and legally workable
Summer in Ibiza includes real leisure, music, friendships and health, not remote overwork
Winter in the UK supports focused property execution
Housing and travel logistics feel sustainable
milestones: Design the ideal year month by month
Agree the rhythm and trade-offs with my wife
Model housing, travel, tax and business costs
Run a shorter seasonal trial
Review energy, relationships, costs and productivity
Commit to the sustainable long-term version
next_actions: Draft the ideal 12-month calendar
Define what “doing things I enjoy” means in weekly life
Discuss non-negotiables and concerns with my wife
open_questions: Which exact months belong in Ibiza and the UK?
Where in London or the UK will you live during winter?
Will you rent, own or use flexible accommodation in each place?
How will the plan support future family needs?
What weekly activities make Ibiza life worth designing?
risks: Creating two expensive bases without enough use
Carrying work intensity into the place meant to provide freedom
Designing the plan without enough shared input

outcomes.title: Build close, successful friendship circles in London and Ibiza
outcomes.outcome_statement: Create a close group of successful friends in London and Ibiza.
outcomes.why: Freedom and achievement will feel hollow without belonging, fun, mutual support and people to share life with.
definition_of_done: There are trusted friends in both locations, not only a large network
Relationships include regular shared experiences and mutual support
Friendships are based on character and connection, not status alone
The social rhythm respects Phil’s need for quiet recharge time

success_metrics.label: New people met
success_metrics.target: Daily aspiration; sustainable target to define

milestones: Define the qualities of the friendships wanted
Use networking and interest-based events to meet aligned people
Follow up consistently through the Social CRM
Create recurring invitations and shared rituals
Invest more deeply in reciprocal relationships
Review whether the circle feels energising, safe and genuine
next_actions: Define what “close” and “successful” mean without making friendship transactional
Set a sustainable weekly meeting and follow-up rhythm
Choose two recurring London communities to invest in
open_questions: How many close friends would feel like enough in each place?
Which values and qualities matter most?
What activities naturally create repeated contact?
How much social time feels energising rather than draining?
risks: Mistaking networking volume for friendship
Choosing people mainly for perceived success
Overcommitting socially and losing recovery time

outcomes.title: Build a trusted 100k audience on YouTube and Instagram
outcomes.outcome_statement: Become well known through 100,000 YouTube subscribers and 100,000 Instagram followers.
outcomes.why: Build creative fulfilment, reputation, leverage, opportunities and distribution for the businesses and life story.
definition_of_done: YouTube reaches 100,000 genuine subscribers
Instagram reaches 100,000 genuine followers
The audience associates Phil with a clear promise and body of work
Content supports the life and businesses without becoming an empty vanity machine

success_metrics.label: Audience value
success_metrics.target: Trust and useful outcomes to define

milestones: Define the audience, promise and content pillars
Choose the relationship between personal brand, Airbnb, property and life design
Establish a sustainable publishing system
Reach the first proof milestones
Double down on formats that create trust and retention
Build collaborations and distribution
Reach 100k on each platform without sacrificing credibility
next_actions: Record current audience baselines
Define who the content is for and why they should care
Choose a 90-day publishing cadence
open_questions: What should Phil be well known for?
Who is the primary audience?
Is the content business-led, life-design-led, property-led or a deliberate combination?
What publication pace can be sustained alongside work and business?
What matters beyond follower count: leads, revenue, opportunities, impact or community?
risks: Chasing follower count without a clear audience promise
Trying to cover too many identities at once
Burnout from an unrealistic content cadence

global_questions.question: What is the target year for the fully designed life, and what must be true within the next 12 months?
What does your wife want this shared life to look and feel like?
What monthly household income and cash reserve create genuine safety?
Which two outcomes are the priority for the next 90 days?
What health, energy and relationship standards must the plan protect?
How will you know you are free before every financial goal is complete?
